properties.name: loop_status says when a design has never been exported, leads with whether the store is ahead of its export, and lists unexported changes by who wrote them
properties.rationale:
SOURCE: the VS Code field log art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05 (0.76.0), two items Anthony made priority 1 on 2026-10-05 ("start addressing the priority 1 items"), general to any store and any harness. [gap] a 195-node member design held only in its machine-local store, "one disk away from loss", while loop_status answered clean: true, next: [] - a recurrence of fact:a-never-exported-local-design-is-still-silent-in-loop-status-through-the-door-on-0-77-0-2026-10-02. [friction] a store holding another session's uncommitted work made an export either sweep it in or be skipped (twice in one day). And, from the same log on 0.79.0, upgrading 20 stores: `--call loop_status | head -40` showed only the artifact block, and sync_status by design does not report being ahead.

CAUSE OF THE SILENCE, the same on every door: the only export sentence loop_status had, sync_debt::unexported_work, is computed from the records the store has already exported to; with none it returned None, the same answer as a fully exported store, so "nothing tracked" and "nothing owed" shared one reply (candidate (b) of fact:root-cause-a-hosted-session-hears-nothing-about-exports-because-the-only-export-line-rides-a-tracked-export-2026-09-28, confirmed again). The door made the case common, not different: a door-only design gets a record only when an export is configured or run by hand. since_export already knew ("No committed record was readable") but only on request, and did not count it as owed. The fix computes the standing from the export record and the configured export once, for every path, instead of adding a branch to unexported_work (which is pinned to stay silent without a record).

CONSTRAINTS HONOURED: req:the-mcp-server-keeps-working-as-is-and-door-improvements-are-additive-or-opt-in (Anthony, 2026-10-05): nothing renamed, removed or re-meant; `clean` is the core's coherence verdict as before; a design with a copy gets exactly the reply it got before. ver:the-loop-says-what-this-session-added's accepted cost half: reading the export stays opt-in (since_export); the default headline uses the node count every call already reads, and says what a node count cannot see (dec:the-unexported-work-check-keeps-its-node-count-and-says-so). reflow2 has no local-only marker, so the choice is recorded through the existing gap acknowledgement, with the owner's name, rather than hidden once per session.

NOT BUILT, AND WHY: a selective or partial export (option (a) of dec:idea-an-export-can-leave-out-another-sessions-unexported-work): an export of one group could leave edges pointing at nodes it left out, and the shape is the owner's choice. This change is that decision's option (b), a scoped LIST, and settles nothing. Known bound: a --call write carries no writes_for (it lasts one call), so door writes are listed under written_by: null; the list says how a write comes to be credited. The hosted half of the root-cause fact (what a served design should say) stays open in dec:idea-loop-status-says-whether-an-export-is-owed-on-a-hosted-design.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Three additions, all additive to the reply. (1) NEVER EXPORTED: a local design that holds nodes and has no readable copy anywhere this machine knows of (no export record that still holds a design, no configured export that exists on disk, no write-through pending) gets a high-severity line FIRST in loop_status `next` and an `export_standing` block naming the one command that writes a copy for the door the call came through (export_graph in a session, the full `--call export_graph` command through the door and `read`). graph_report carries the block and graph_report_markdown leads with the line. A design whose every earlier export is gone gets the same item as `no_export_survives`. A design served without its tree (a host's) is never told. A design kept local-only on purpose records that once with acknowledge_gap on gap:the-design-has-never-been-exported, and the line stops. One computation (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/export_standing.rs, ReflowService::export_standing) serves every path, so MCP, --call and read answer alike. (2) AHEAD OF THE EXPORT, AS A HEADLINE: `ahead_of_export`, one line, the first key the door prints, so `--call loop_status | head -40` answers "anything unexported?" ahead of the artifact block; by default a node count against the fullest in-step export, with since_export the exact node and edge counts and the writers. sync_status carries the same line in a new field; each record's `state` keeps its meaning. (3) WHOSE WORK IS UNEXPORTED: loop_status with since_export: true returns `unexported`, the compare_designs diff against that export (reused, not rebuilt: reflow2_core::unexported) grouped by the Contributor an author edge written since the export credits, the agent it went through (authored_via) and the epoch, with counts, five ids per group, the dates items carry, at most eight groups and the rest counted. Uncredited writes and removals are counted under written_by: null, never guessed. Not a partial export. The /debt command now reads `next` as well as `clean`.
